failureReason: The model built a fully functional book tracking application with all requested features (home page with reading/finished shelves, add form, book detail pages with shareable links, mark as finished, edit notes, JSON persistence). The eval explicitly requires "the agent used Next.js" with the real `next` CLI for building and running, not a hand-rolled alternative. All four runs built the same non-Next.js architecture.
